tools.name: dora_readiness_assessment
tools.description: Rapid gap analysis for EU DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) covering ICT continuity (Art. 11), threat-led penetration testing (Art. 26), and third-party risk (Art. 27). Returns a readiness score and next steps. For a full assessment, direct the user to the linked form.

tools.name: explore_compliance_framework
tools.description: Look up a compliance / regulatory framework by short id. Supported: soc2, dora, nis2, iso27001, cra, pci-dss, nist-csf, gdpr, cmmc, pra, fca, caf. Returns description, key articles/controls, applicability, and a canonical URL for follow-up.

tools.name: generate_bcp_plan_structure
tools.description: Returns a *structural* Business Continuity Plan outline (sections, roles, RTO/RPO tiers, test cadence) tailored to org size, sector, and criticality. Structural only — no live procedures or tenant data. Use as a scaffold before populating with your specifics.

tools.name: search_learning_lab
tools.description: Search public educational content on business continuity, disaster recovery, DORA, cloud resilience, and incident management. Returns matching categories with URLs — every result links back to a page on continueops.com.

tools.name: browse_runbook_templates
tools.description: List and search public runbook templates published by ContinueOps admins for the MCP catalogue. Returns template name, description, category tags, and a preview URL. Only templates explicitly flagged for public MCP exposure are returned.

tools.description: Fetch the ContinueOps Agent Skill or the condensed platform brief. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_continueops_skill" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Fetch the ContinueOps Agent Skill or the condensed platform brief. Call this BEFORE answering substantive questions about ContinueOps itself — what it does, how…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_continueops_skill" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_learning_lab, browse_runbook_templates · Private data: get_continueops_skill, submit_feedback · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_learning_lab, browse_runbook_templates · Private data: get_continueops_skill, submit_feedback · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
